title: Chiune Sugihara Memorial Hall

buildingCutout.basis: Only the mapped memorial building and its attached wing.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation at the parking approach immediately outside the main timber porch.

mapIdentity.scope: The L-shaped OSM plan and parking edge fix the tall eastern rectangle and attached low western roofs. Both original Qualla photos show the main north door facing the parking approach with the low wing extending to its west.

note: The town’s municipal facility plan records a two-story wood building of 293.7 square metres completed in 2000. The operator identifies Gifu hinoki timber. The exact Qualla photos fix the projecting gable and angled timber lattice, glazed upper gable and lower wood wing.
